digest.component_or_area: agent tooling and source-code navigation guidance
propositions: Agents prefer grep over Serena symbol tools despite documentation because grep has zero friction while Serena discovery requires an extra ToolSearch round-trip

Serena's symbol-resolution cannot find references to symbols used as string literals (e.g., monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib patterns), causing agents to miss real call sites if they rely on it exclusively

The current documentation rule 'prefer symbol tools over grep' is incomplete and incorrect in important cases, teaching agents to discount it; the guidance must encode the division of labour between tools rather than a bare preference
A PreToolUse hook on Bash grep invocations can re-surface Serena at the moment of action, reducing friction asymmetry and keeping the exception honest
Project-specific criteria and coaching moves can direct re-derivation of incompletely enumerated source references via Serena when plan review detects hand enumeration
Removing the discovery friction for Serena symbol tools in this repo (via ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH pinned in tracked .claude/settings.json) makes the preferred path cost zero extra steps
